Maya (CSM): Heads-up — SlateBridge MAU collapsed ~78% this week vs last month, and embedding calls are nearly absent. seeing big drop in rerank traffic too. :alarm_clock:
Rafi (AM): yikes. any platform errors or auth failures?
Maya (CSM): none. infra looks healthy. dashboard link (internal): https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/slatebridge/usage
Lina (RevOps): I spoke with their PM champion earlier  they said procurement paused while new Head of Data evaluates an on-prem POC with NimbusOps focusing on cost + tail latency at scale.
Owen (Solutions Eng): Do we know their pilot goals? seq lengths, qps, p99 requirements?
Lina (RevOps): Pilot goal: rerank throughput of 100q/s with p99 < 120ms and cost targets aligned with their cost-per-inference budget. Pilot currently sized small (10k queries/day).
Rafi (AM): Renewal in 45 days. this looks actionable. Maya, want to own a triage call?
Maya (CSM): yes. recommend 30-min POV call with new Head of Data + champion to run our perf/cost benchmarks and show migration friction.
Owen (Solutions Eng): I can produce a 1-page perf summary comparing Redwood Dedicated vs a typical on-prem stack for their seq/batch profile. need their exact batch sizes.
Maya (CSM): champion reported batch=128 for offline rerank, avg seq ~420 tokens.
Lina (RevOps): I'll prepare a short cost delta showing impact of batching, KV caching, and quantization options. can we throw in a time-limited trial offer?
Rafi (AM): check contract. LegalBot, any restrictions on offering a two-week dedicated trial to accounts mid-term?
LegalBot: Auto-reply: Standard trial addendum permitted for accounts with < 12 months remaining; consult contract team for custom terms.
Owen (Solutions Eng): Proposed play: 1) run a controlled replication for their batch=128/seq=420 workload on a dedicated cluster, 2) provide sample promptset to validate quality parity, 3) produce an apples-to-apples cost + latency report.
Maya (CSM): perfect. if we can demonstrate cost parity or better and low migration effort, renewals should be salvageable.
Lina (RevOps): I'm drafting the cost table now. also flagging finance for projected revenue impact.
Rafi (AM): I'll reach out to schedule tomorrow afternoon PT. Maya, loop in the champion + new Head of Data.
Maya (CSM): scheduled 2pm PT tomorrow. invite sent.
Owen (Solutions Eng): I'll have the bench numbers and the one-pager ready within 4 hours.
Lina (RevOps): adding internal note: "At-risk: usage drop + new HoD running competitor POC; triage call scheduled 2pm PT"
Rafi (AM): action items recap: Maya = run call & collect pilot artifacts; Owen = bench + one-pager; Lina = cost delta & finance note; I'll handle contract check and outreach.
LegalBot: Flag created for Contracts review.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Post the artifacts to the SlateBridge account folder after the call. We'll update the renewal playbook depending on findings. :white_check_mark:
